scope.not_completed: All EN pages; sitemap XML was blocked by the browser client, so no claim of complete inventory is made.

observed_findings.title: Visible page uses a coherent InsightValues identity
observed_findings.evidence: Masthead link, content label, footer heading, and ecosystem statement all expose InsightValues/IVE identity.

observed_findings.title: Navigation exposes PT/EN language links
observed_findings.evidence: Primary navigation exposes Português → /inteligencia/ and English → /en/intelligence/. Pair completeness not verified.

observed_findings.title: Article navigation includes a mixed-locale route
observed_findings.evidence: The EN Intelligence listing contains a Building IVE article linking to /inteligencia-artificial/building-ive-google-adk-gemini/; locale policy must decide whether this is intentional.

observed_findings.title: Full EN inventory and link health remain unverified
observed_findings.evidence: Native browser XML navigation was blocked; one page cannot prove complete URL coverage or all persistent defects.

observed_findings.title: Top-level heading structure is not uniform across inspected EN pages
observed_findings.evidence: Native accessibility trees exposed an H2 page title on /en/, /en/about/, and /en/contact/, while /en/ecosystem/ and /en/ive-2/ exposed H1 page titles. Confirm against DOM heading markup and the approved semantic standard.

observed_findings.title: Locale route patterns vary across inspected EN pages
observed_findings.evidence: Observed PT links include /, /ecossistema/, /ive/, /quem-somos/, /contato/, and /inteligencia/; confirm these are intentional canonical pairs and that hreflang is consistent.

observed_findings.title: Shared footer/legal topology persisted across inspected EN pages
observed_findings.evidence: All five inspected EN pages exposed Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, Cookie Policy, Comments Policy, About/Explore footer structure, and © 2026 InsightValues.

next_execution: Run the adapter against the profile with sitemap access or a supplied approved URL inventory; retain this packet as the baseline evidence, not as a complete production audit.
